Welcome to the Partner API documentation. Our system provides secure, high-performance API endpoints for resellers and partners to automate Gemini account upgrades and retrieve pre-purchased stock accounts from the store.

Your Base URL:
https://lahastore.up.railway.app/api/v1

Authentication

Every request sent to the API must include your personal API key:

  • Passed as an HTTP Header: X-API-Key: [REDACTED-PRODSELLER-KEY]
  • Or passed directly in the JSON payload body: "psk_key": "[REDACTED-PRODSELLER-KEY]"

To generate or rotate your API Key, please message /api directly to the Telegram Bot.

Gemini Task API (/gateway)

All task actions are routed through a single POST endpoint using the action field to determine the operation.

POST /gateway

Unified endpoint for checking balances, submitting tasks, retrieving status, and cancelling tasks.

1. Get Balance & Prices (get_balance)

Payload
{ "action": "get_balance", "psk_key": "psk_your_api_key" }
Response
{ "success": true, "balance_usd": 12.5000, "balance_vnd": 305000, "price_full_usd": 1.5, "price_extract_usd": 1.0, "price_full_vnd": 38000, "price_extract_vnd": 25000 }

2. Submit Upgrade Task (submit_task)

Payload
{ "action": "submit_task", "psk_key": "psk_your_api_key", "email": "customer@gmail.com", "password": "customerpassword", "twofa": "ABCD1234EFGH5678", // (Optional) "task_type": "full", // "full" or "extract" "currency": "usd" // "usd" or "vnd" }
Response
{ "success": true, "task_id": "TK-3F1B22", "order_code": "PT17831...", "message": "Task submitted successfully.", "balance_after_usd": 11.0, "balance_after_vnd": 305000 }

3. Query Task Status (get_status)

Payload
{ "action": "get_status", "psk_key": "psk_your_api_key", "task_id": "TK-3F1B22" }
Response
{ "success": true, "data": { "task_id": "TK-3F1B22", "email": "customer@gmail.com", "task_type": "full", "status": "Success", // "Pending", "Running", "Success", "Failed" "message": "Upgrade completed successfully!", "has_offer_url": false, "offer_url": null, "created_at": "2026-07-04 17:35:06" } }

4. Cancel Queued Task (cancel_task)

Only tasks in Pending or Running state can be cancelled. The deducted balance will be refunded automatically.

Payload
{ "action": "cancel_task", "psk_key": "psk_your_api_key", "task_id": "TK-3F1B22" }
Response
{ "success": true, "message": "Task cancelled. Refunded: $1.50." }

Get Products List (REST)

GET /products

Retrieves all active items available in the shop, including bulk prices, flash sale rates, and real-time stock levels.
Note: Products closed by Admin (inactive) are automatically excluded and cannot be ordered via API.

Query Filters & Pagination:
?category=Gemini | ?type=account (or preorder) | ?search=keyword | ?in_stock=1 | ?page=1&limit=50

Response
{ "ok": true, "success": true, "code": "SUCCESS", "products": [ { "id": 12, "productId": 12, "code": "gemini_standard", "name": "Gemini Pro Account (1 Month)", "title": "Gemini Pro Account (1 Month)", "category": "Gemini Pro", "productType": "account", // "account" (instant) or "preorder" "price": 35000, "priceVnd": 35000, "priceUsd": 1.45, "stock": 25, // Integer or "preorder" "soldCount": 120 } ], "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 50, "total": 1, "totalPages": 1 } }

Check Balance (REST)

GET /balance

Returns your current balance on both VND and USD wallets.

Response
{ "ok": true, "success": true, "code": "SUCCESS", "shopId": "TG123456789", "balance": 500000, "balanceText": "500.000đ", "balanceUsd": 20.00, "balanceUsdText": "$20.00" }

Purchase Stock & Pre-order (REST)

POST /orders
POST /products/:id/buy

Deducts balance and delivers credentials instantly for normal items (productType: "account"). For pre-order items (productType: "preorder"), an order is created with status pending_preorder for Admin fulfillment. Supports idempotent check via shopOrderId.

Parameter Type Required Description
productId / URL :id Integer No ID of the product (Required if code is empty)
code String No Product code identifier (Required if productId is empty)
qty / quantity Integer No Quantity to buy (1 to 100). Default: 1
currency String No Wallet choice: "vnd" or "usd". Default: "vnd"
shopOrderId String No Idempotency key from your system. Retrying the same key returns the original order without charging again.
Payload
{ "code": "gemini_standard", "qty": 1, "currency": "vnd", "shopOrderId": "BILL-100293" }
Response (Instant Account)
{ "ok": true, "success": true, "code": "SUCCESS", "message": "Mua hàng thành công.", "productType": "account", "order": { "orderCode": "PT1783161306789ZS4F6F", "shopOrderId": "BILL-100293", "product": "Gemini Pro Account (1 Month)", "qty": 1, "price": 35000, "total": 35000, "currency": "vnd", "status": "completed", "balanceAfter": 465000, "accounts": [ "username_account|password_account|recovery_key" ] } }
Response (Pre-order Item)
{ "ok": true, "success": true, "code": "PREORDER_PLACED", "message": "Đơn hàng Pre-order đã ghi nhận. Vui lòng chờ Admin trả hàng.", "productType": "preorder", "order": { "orderCode": "PT1783161308888XX1Y2Z", "shopOrderId": "BILL-100294", "product": "CanBoSo Premium 1 Year (Pre-order)", "qty": 1, "price": 10.00, "total": 10.00, "currency": "usd", "status": "pending_preorder", "balanceAfter": 40.00, "accounts": [] } }

Error Codes Reference

All error responses return standard HTTP status codes along with a structured enum error code in JSON:

Error Format
{ "ok": false, "success": false, "code": "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE", // e.g., INVALID_API_KEY, OUT_OF_STOCK, INVALID_PRODUCT, INVALID_QUANTITY "error": "Insufficient balance. Need: 35.000đ, have: 10.000đ" }

Order History & Details (REST)

GET /orders

Retrieves your account's order history.

Query parameters: ?limit=50 (Default limit: 50), ?includeAccounts=1 (1: returns credentials, 0: summary only).

Response
{ "ok": true, "success": true, "code": "SUCCESS", "orders": [ { "orderCode": "PT1783161306789ZS4F6F", "productName": "Gemini Pro Account (1 Month)", "quantity": 1, "price": 35000, "total": 35000, "currency": "vnd", "status": "completed", "createdAt": "2026-07-04 17:35:06" } ] }
GET /orders/:orderCode

Look up a specific order using its code (e.g. PT1783161306789ZS4F6F).

Response
{ "ok": true, "success": true, "code": "SUCCESS", "order": { "orderCode": "PT1783161306789ZS4F6F", "productName": "Gemini Pro Account (1 Month)", "quantity": 1, "price": 35000, "total": 35000, "currency": "vnd", "status": "completed", "accounts": [ "user@gmail.com|pass|recovery" ], "createdAt": "2026-07-04 17:35:06" } }

Developer Documentation

Activation API

Purchase activation services and retrieve activation history through a simple HTTP API.

Base URL
https://api.acczone.xyz
Authentication
API key via query parameter
Format
JSON responses

Buy Activation

Purchase one or more activation services from available stock.

GET /buyCpn

Creates a new activation purchase.

Request URL
https://api.acczone.xyz/buyCpn?apikey=YOUR_API_KEY&service_key=gemini&quantity=1
Query Parameters
Parameter Type Required Description
apikey string Yes Your API authentication key.
service_key string Yes The service to purchase. Use gemini.
quantity integer Yes Number of activations to purchase. A value of 1 is recommended.
Example Response
[
  {
    "id": 12345,
    "service_key": "gemini",
    "code_type": "text",
    "code_value": "LINK_HERE_COUPON_HERE",
    "is_used": 1,
    "used_by": 123456789,
    "used_at": "2026-09-09 07:10:07",
    "extracted_code": null
  }
]
! Stock may sell out instantly. A quantity of 1 is recommended.

Account Balance

Retrieve your account information and current API balance.

GET /getBalance

Returns account details, API key information, and the current balance.

Request URL
https://api.acczone.xyz/getBalance?apikey=YOUR_API_KEY
Query Parameters
Parameter Type Required Description
apikey string Yes Your API authentication key.
Example Response
{
  "user_id": 1234567890,
  "username": "johndoe",
  "first_name": "John Doe",
  "balance": 451.88,
  "created_at": "2026-09-01 19:49:55",
  "verified_at": "2026-09-01 19:49:55",
  "apikey": "KEY"
}
! Do not expose your API key publicly or commit it to client-side applications.

Available Services

Retrieve the list of activation services currently available through the API.

GET /getServices

Returns an array of available activation services, including their service keys, prices, and active status.

Request URL
https://api.acczone.xyz/getServices
Example Response
[
  {
    "key": "gemini",
    "name": "Gemini Link",
    "price": 0.4,
    "is_active": 1,
    "created_at": "2026-09-01 12:25:23"
  }
]
Response Fields
Field Type Description
key string Unique service key used when purchasing an activation.
name string Display name of the service.
price number Price per activation.
is_active integer Service status. 1 means active and 0 means inactive.
created_at string Date and time when the service was created.
! Only services with is_active equal to 1 should be used for new purchases.

Activation History

Retrieve previously created activation records using pagination.

GET /getHistory

Returns a paginated list of activation records.

Request URL
https://api.acczone.xyz/getHistory?apikey=YOUR_API_KEY&page=1&limit=20
Query Parameters
Parameter Type Required Description
apikey string Yes Your API authentication key.
page integer Yes Page number to retrieve, starting from 1.
limit integer Yes Number of records to return. Maximum: 100.
Example Response
[
  {
    "id": 67149,
    "service_key": "test181",
    "code_value": "Testing42",
    "used_at": "2026-09-09 07:10:07"
  },
  {
    "id": 66815,
    "service_key": "test181",
    "code_value": "Testing4",
    "used_at": "2026-09-09 06:34:55"
  },
  {
    "id": 66814,
    "service_key": "test181",
    "code_value": "Testing3",
    "used_at": "2026-09-09 06:33:24"
  }
]

HTTP Status Codes

Status Description
200 OK Request completed successfully.
400 Bad Request The request contains an invalid parameter or another API error.
429 Too Many Requests Rate limit exceeded. Maximum of one request every two seconds.
Error Response
{
  "detail": "ERROR HERE"
}

Pagination

The history endpoint uses page-based pagination.

Parameter Rules
page Starts at 1.
limit Minimum 1, maximum 100.
